reason: The page's TLS fixture uses a self-signed certificate, which a context accepts with acceptInsecureCerts. Chromium refuses acceptInsecureCerts with Unsupported, because its certificate override applies to the whole browser

The original skips WebKit for this test ("No third party cookies in WebKit" for HE-010, and "Our WebKit embedder does not respect window features" for HE-011), so the port runs it on the other browsers only

The test launches a second browser headless next to the headed one. WebKitGTK has no headless mode, so the second launch is refused with InvalidInput, as the matrix row's webkit.launched override says
